onboarding_welcome_body: Kalo helps you log food, exercise, and weight through conversation, then uses your real data to build a practical weight-loss plan with you. Complete the essentials in about a minute.
onboarding_privacy_note: Health records stay in this browser. AI requests go directly to the model service you configure.
onboarding_profile_body: These details estimate your basal metabolism and daily expenditure. You can set a target weight with Kalo later.
onboarding_ai_body: Kalo uses the model service you choose directly. Enter a compatible endpoint, model ID, and API key.
onboarding_ai_privacy_body: The API key is stored in plain text in this browser's IndexedDB. Do not configure it on a public device. Direct browser access also requires the endpoint to allow CORS.
onboarding_ai_required: An AI connection is required for Kalo to understand conversations and use tools.

memory_privacy_body: Memory stays in this browser. It is read when you first send a message in a new chat and refreshed when you next send a message after it changes. The resulting snapshot is sent to your configured model service with later requests in that chat and is included in full backups.
memory_clear_message: Clearing creates a new empty memory version. Existing chats retain historical snapshots and will sync the empty version the next time you send a message. This cannot be restored automatically.
settings_clear_body: Clearing data removes every profile, log, chat, image, Kalo memory note, and API key from this browser and cannot be undone.

help_overview_body: Use chat to log food, exercise, and weight; correct or delete mistakes; negotiate weight-loss goals; and review daily calories, macros, and weight trends on the dashboard. All health data stays in this browser.
help_tdee_intro: Kalo distinguishes three related values so the theoretical formula, recent trend, and final calorie budget are not confused.
help_tdee_formula_body: Kalo calculates BMR with your selected formula, then applies the activity factor. Mifflin–St Jeor is the default; after providing body fat, you can choose lean-mass-based Katch–McArdle.
help_tdee_adaptive_body: Kalo infers recent daily expenditure from roughly 14 days of average intake and a robust Theil-Sen weight trend, with a confidence score.
help_tdee_effective_body: It is a confidence-weighted blend of Formula TDEE and Adaptive TDEE, and the value Kalo actually uses for daily calorie budgets and goal planning.
help_tdee_caution: When data is insufficient or the trend is implausible, Effective TDEE uses the formula alone. These values are estimates, not a professional metabolic test.
help_api_body: In AI configuration, choose the API protocol and enter a Base URL, API key, and Model ID. Choose OpenAI Completions for most OpenAI-compatible services, or Anthropic Messages for the official Claude API. Direct browser access requires the service to allow CORS.
help_images_body: Kalo can process an image only when both the selected model and API endpoint support image or vision input. The image button is always visible in chat, but that does not guarantee that the configured model has vision capabilities. Text-only models, self-hosted services, and some OpenAI-compatible gateways may reject image requests. If an image request fails, check that the model documentation mentions vision, image input, or multimodal support and that the endpoint accepts base64 images.
help_cloud_body: OpenRouter is a convenient starting point. Choose a model from its free collection or use the free model router. Select OpenAI Completions and normally use https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 as the Base URL. Free services may have rate, availability, and privacy limitations.
help_local_body: If your hardware allows it, run a model on your own device so chat requests can remain on your local network. The service must expose an OpenAI-compatible API and allow browser CORS. Model quality and tool-calling support depend on the chosen model and server.
help_desktop_body: Ollama and llama.cpp are recommended. Start a compatible API server, then enter its address as the Base URL and use the corresponding Model ID.
help_android_body: You can install Ollama or llama.cpp through Termux, or try MNN Chat. To connect it to Kalo AI, the solution still needs to expose a compatible API that the browser can reach.
help_ios_body: There is currently no recommended local-LLM runtime and API setup for iOS. For now, use a trusted cloud service and review the provider's data-handling policy.
help_security_body: This app runs entirely in the frontend and has no backend components. Health data, chat images, Kalo's memory, and your API key stay in this browser; AI requests, attached images, and memory snapshots read by the current chat are sent directly to the model service you configure and never pass through a Kalo AI server. The API key is stored in plain text in IndexedDB, and images, memory, and the key are included in full backups. Never store secrets in memory, avoid unnecessary sensitive images, and never share backup files publicly.
about_description: Kalo AI is an agent-native, local-first companion for healthy weight loss. It understands natural language and uses tools to help log and revise food, exercise, weight, and goals while providing ongoing guidance from your data.
about_privacy_body: Health records, chat images, Kalo's memory, and your API key stay in your browser. AI requests, attached images, and memory snapshots read by a chat are sent directly to the model service you configure.
about_open_source_body: Kalo AI is open source on GitHub. You are welcome to inspect the code, report issues, or contribute improvements.
disclaimer_body: Content from Kalo AI is generated by a large language model and is provided only for general information and personal tracking. It is not medical, nutritional, or other professional advice. Language models may provide incorrect information because their knowledge can be inaccurate, outdated, or hallucinated. Verify important information yourself, and consult a qualified clinician or professional for health risks, medical conditions, medication, or major diet and exercise changes.
